units.source_text: 和琴的音调虽不是那么细腻，但由于有深通此道之人精心传授，

en.t: Though the tone of the wagon was not especially delicate, because someone deeply versed in the art had taught it with great care,

units.source_text: 因此，虽是同一曲调，却弹出了特别凄凉动人的情味。

en.t: therefore, even though it was the same melody, it produced a feeling that was especially sorrowful and moving.

units.source_text: 可惜只弹几句，就此停止，竟使夕雾恨恨不已。

en.t: Unfortunately, after playing only a few phrases, she stopped, leaving Yugiri deeply disappointed.

units.source_text: 对老夫人说道：“今夜小生在好几个乐器上弹出了种种心事，已蒙公主垂察。

en.t: He said to the old lady, "Tonight, on several instruments, I have played out the many thoughts in my heart, and the princess has graciously perceived them.

units.source_text: 秋夜更深，扰人清睡，恐蒙故人呵责，就此告辞了。

en.t: The autumn night has grown late, and if I disturb her peaceful sleep, I fear my late friend would reproach me, so I shall take my leave now.

units.source_text: 稍迟数日，当再前来奉候，但愿此琴调子依然不变。

en.t: In a few days I shall come again to pay my respects; I only hope this koto remains tuned just as it is.

units.source_text: 世间常有变调之事，不免教人担心耳。”

en.t: In this world, tunes often change, and that cannot help but make one anxious."

units.source_text: 他没有明言，只是委婉地暗示了自己的心事，便欲离去。

en.t: He did not speak plainly, but only hinted gently at what was in his heart, and then was about to leave.

units.source_text: 老夫人答道：“今宵风流韵事，想来不致受人谴责。

en.t: The old lady replied, "Tonight's elegant and romantic affair will surely not bring anyone's reproach.

units.source_text: 惟你我漫谈，尽是琐屑旧事，未能听赏妙手演奏，使我得以延年益寿，不胜遗憾耳。”

en.t: It is only a great pity that you and I idly talked of trivial old matters, and I could not hear and enjoy a masterful performance that might have lengthened my life."

units.source_text: 便在赠物中添加一支横笛，对他说道：“此笛确有悠久之历史，听其埋没在此蓬门陋屋之中，实甚可惜。

en.t: She then added a transverse flute to the gifts and said to him, "This flute truly has a long history, and it is a great pity to let it lie buried in this humble dwelling.

units.source_text: 请君在归车中试吹，与前驱之声竞响，路人亦无不爱听也。”

en.t: Please try playing it in your carriage on the way home; if it vies in sound with the voices of your outriders, every passerby will surely love to listen."

units.source_text: 夕雾逊谢道：“如此美笛，恐我无福消受。”

en.t: Yugiri modestly declined, saying, "I fear I am not blessed enough to receive such a beautiful flute."

units.source_text: 拿起笛来看看，这也是柏木生前随身爱玩之物。

en.t: He picked up the flute and looked at it; this too had been an object Kashiwagi loved and kept near him while he was alive.

units.source_text: 记得柏木常对他说：“此笛所有妙音，我亦未能全般吹出，将来总须传与我所信任之人。”

en.t: He remembered that Kashiwagi had often said to him, "Even I have not been able to draw out all the wonderful tones of this flute; someday I must pass it on to someone I trust."

units.source_text: 回思往事，又平添了许多哀愁。

en.t: Thinking back on the past added still more sorrow to his heart.

units.source_text: 便拿起笛来试吹，吹了半曲南吕调就停止，说道：“为了怀念故人，弹和琴以自慰，拙劣之处，当蒙原恕。

en.t: He then picked up the flute and tried playing it, but stopped halfway through a piece in the Nanryo mode, saying, "To remember my late friend, I played the wagon to console myself; please forgive my clumsiness.

units.source_text: 但这管名笛，实在不好意思……”说罢起身欲出。

en.t: But as for this famous flute, I truly feel unworthy..." Having said this, he rose and was about to leave.
The old lady presented him with a poem, saying:
